description: Starts connecting a service to a project. Collect the settings list_connectable_services marks as settings in chat first, never a key, password or token. The person then finishes on a CodeGene page (or the service's own sign-in) that this call opens for them or returns as a link. Owners and admins only. If your prompt or page never appears and the call times out, call it again with finish_with set to "link".

account_label.description: A name for this connection, such as the account's email.

finish_with.description: Leave out. "link" returns a CodeGene page link for the person to open instead of showing a prompt or opening the page for them, for an assistant that cannot.

settings.description: The service's settings that are not secret, by setting id, such as a server address. Never a key, password or token.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: connect_service
title: Connect a service
